title: MGM Grand — Overview and history
body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference. MGM Grand is a massive hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip, opened on December 18, 1993, by MGM Resorts International. With about 6,850 guest rooms it is among the largest hotels in the world. The resort includes the MGM Grand Garden Arena, a major venue for championship boxing, concerts, and the Academy of Country Music Awards, plus the David Copperfield Theater and KÀ by Cirque du Soleil.

body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference. title: MGM Grand — Visiting, hours, and access
body: Public edition. Public records, fact-checked reference. Open 24 hours; 21+ on the casino floor. Located at Tropicana Avenue on the Strip's south end, connected to the monorail. The pool complex is seasonal. Arena events require tickets.
